## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (C examples checked in a container if you are not on Linux; see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Generated files are up to date: `npm run build:labs`, `npm run build:glossary`, `npm run build:search`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test, and a bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] If a page layout changed: `npm run audit` is clean
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under **Unreleased** if learners or instructors would notice the change
- [ ] The text is written for a newcomer, is neutral (no institution's branding), and any new code sample exists in both C and Python
